## get and clean gene expression data for lncRNA genes implicated in cancer
list of lncRNA is from:
from paper https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/152769v3.supplementary-material
also published in Now published in Communications Biology doi: 10.1038/s42003-019-0741-7

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

# read in target genes and reshaped expression data (Depmap 2023Q2)
nc_genes<- readxl::read_xlsx(path = "../input/CLC_non_coding_cancer_genes.xlsx", col_names = T, sheet = 2)

expression_data<- read_csv(file="../input/target_lines_transcriptome_data.csv")

data<- read_csv(file="../input/OmicsProfiles.csv")
model<- read_csv(file="../input/Model.csv")

# get the transcript data for selected genes

library(biomaRt)

ensembl=useEnsembl(biomart="genes",dataset="hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = 110)   # dataset and database chosen.

transcript_data_nc_genes = getBM(attributes = c('external_gene_name','ensembl_transcript_id','transcript_length','ensembl_gene_id',"transcript_biotype" ),filters = 'ensembl_gene_id', values = nc_genes$`GENCODE ID`, mart = ensembl)
transcript_data_nc_genes<- transcript_data_nc_genes %>% dplyr::rename(Gene=external_gene_name, Transcript_ID=ensembl_transcript_id)
write_csv(transcript_data_nc_genes, file=paste0("../output/trancript_data_lncRNA_genes_", Sys.Date(),".csv"))

target_cell_lines_data<- data %>% filter(ProfileID %in% names(expression_data))

column_names<- left_join(target_cell_lines_data, model, by="ModelID")

expression_data <- expression_data %>% mutate(Transcript_ID = str_replace_all(Data_name, "\\(|\\)", "")) %>% separate(Transcript_ID, into=c("Gene", "Transcript_ID")) %>% dplyr::select(!Data_name)
nc_RNA_expression_data<- expression_data %>% filter(Transcript_ID %in% transcript_data_nc_genes$Transcript_ID)
length(unique(nc_RNA_expression_data$Gene))

colnames<- as.data.frame(names(nc_RNA_expression_data))
colnames
names(colnames)[1]<-"ProfileID"
colnames<- left_join(colnames, column_names, by="ProfileID")
colnames<- colnames[1:10,]
colnames(nc_RNA_expression_data)[1:10]<-colnames$StrippedCellLineName


```

## select abundant transcripts
```{r}

combined_transcript_data<- inner_join(nc_RNA_expression_data,transcript_data_nc_genes, by=c("Transcript_ID","Gene"))

b<- as.data.frame(table(combined_transcript_data$Gene, combined_transcript_data$transcript_biotype)) %>% filter(Freq>0)

levels(as.factor(combined_transcript_data$transcript_biotype))

combined_transcript_data<- combined_transcript_data %>% filter(transcript_biotype %in% c("lncRNA","protein_coding" ,"protein_coding", "misc_RNA","processed_transcript", "TEC")) 

print(paste("we have both transcript and expression data for",length(unique(combined_transcript_data$Gene)),"/",nrow(nc_genes), "lncRNA genes. "))
```

```{r}

#find transcripts with the highest expression in selected cell lines
names(combined_transcript_data)

melted_transcript_data<- reshape2::melt(combined_transcript_data,id.vars=c("Gene", "Transcript_ID", "ensembl_gene_id", "transcript_biotype","transcript_length"  ))
levels(melted_transcript_data$variable)
max_exp<- melted_transcript_data%>% group_by(Gene, variable) %>% summarise(max=max(value))

melted_transcript_data<- left_join(melted_transcript_data, max_exp, by=c("Gene", "variable"))
melted_transcript_data<-melted_transcript_data %>% mutate(gene_max_tr="none") %>% mutate(gene_max_tr=case_when(
  value <1 ~"low",
  value==max ~ "max",
  TRUE~"none"
))  

max_exp_melted_transcript_data<-melted_transcript_data %>% filter(gene_max_tr=="max") %>% droplevels()
max_exp_melted_transcript_data$selection_criteria<- "max_exp"

length(unique(max_exp_melted_transcript_data$Gene))

#select the longest transcript for the unexpressed genes
unexpressed_genes<- melted_transcript_data %>% filter(!(Gene %in% max_exp_melted_transcript_data$Gene))
unexpressed_genes<-unexpressed_genes  %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  mutate(max_transcript_length = max(transcript_length)) %>%
  ungroup()
unexpressed_genes<- unexpressed_genes %>% filter(transcript_length==max_transcript_length)
unexpressed_genes$selection_criteria<- "max_length"


#combine together expressed and unexpressed genes
selected_lncRNA_transcripts<- rbind((max_exp_melted_transcript_data %>% dplyr::select(Gene, Transcript_ID, transcript_length, transcript_biotype, selection_criteria, ensembl_gene_id)),(unexpressed_genes %>% dplyr::select(Gene, Transcript_ID, transcript_length, transcript_biotype, selection_criteria, ensembl_gene_id))) %>% unique()


print(paste("I identified transcripts with maximum expression for different cell lines for", length(unique(max_exp_melted_transcript_data$Gene)),"genes and obtained a total of", length(unique(max_exp_melted_transcript_data$Transcript_ID)), "transcripts. For remaining", length(unique(unexpressed_genes$Gene)), "genes I picked the longest transcript. In the final list I obtained", nrow(selected_lncRNA_transcripts), "transcripts for", length(unique(selected_lncRNA_transcripts$Gene)),"/", nrow(nc_genes), "cancer related lncRNA genes"))

write_csv(selected_lncRNA_transcripts, file=paste0("../output/selected_lncRNA_transcripts_",Sys.Date(), ".csv"))

```
